text:
Maya (Sales): Heads-up - HelioHealth POC kickoff 8:30am PT tomorrow. They want committed GPUs for baseline traffic + aggressive burst for demo peaks. Also urgent: security questionnaire needs partial answers by EOD. Can we draft capacity + pricing options to send pre-call?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): quick clarifier - what's their expected baseline and peak? token lengths?
Maya (Sales): they sent estimates: baseline ~250 qps, short spikes up to ~1000 qps for 60-180s, median input ~256 tokens. Target demo latency p50 ~250ms. Model for validation: open-llama-70b, 4-bit quant.
Noah (Infra): ballpark perf: q70B@4bit on V100/A100-class instance ~15 rps per GPU at 256 tokens with small batches; at 1000 qps we'd need ~60-80 GPU-rps -> roughly 4-8 GPUs depending on batching and cache efficiency.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): propose two clear options:
- Option 1 (Predictable commit): 8 reserved A100-equivalent GPUs, autoscale policy allowing +4 burst GPUs (max 12). Prefetched KV cache + batching tuned for short sequences.
- Option 2 (Cost-optimized commit): 5 reserved GPUs + burst credits to scale to 15 for short spikes, with strict burst windows and model fallback.
Maya (Sales): which keeps demo p50/p95 tight?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Option 1 gives stable p50/p95 under demo load. Option 2 meets p50 usually but p95 risk increases during sustained spikes; recommend Option 2 only if they accept fallback rules and can tolerate transient higher tail latency.
Leah (Security): they asked for SOC2, SAML SSO + SCIM, customer-managed KMS, HSM attestation, and 12 month audit log retention. Also want contractual clause preventing export of model weights. Do they require private deployment or is hosted with peering + KMS OK?
Maya (Sales): HelioHealth prefers Private control plane but said they'd consider hosted with strict KMS + VPC peering if we can sign addenda.
Noah (Infra): hosted supports customer-managed KMS and 12mo logs. HSM attestation and air-gapped installs are Private-only and add ~3 weeks lead time and a one-time integration fee.
Ibrahim (AE): need quick cost delta for the two options to include in a one-pager. Jules, can you give monthly ranges for reserved GPUs and an example burst-hour cost?
Jules (Finance): rough numbers: reserved A100-equivalent ~ $19k-22k / GPU / month depending on commit term. On-demand burst ~2.8-3.2x the reserved rate per GPU-hour. Example monthly sketches: 
- Option 1 (8 reserved + burst to 12): baseline ~8 * $20k = $160k / month.
- Option 2 (5 reserved + burst to 15): baseline ~5 * $20k = $100k / month; assume 100-200 GPU-hours burst -> add ~$10k-20k variable.
Also add Private control plane setup one-time fee estimate: $30k-$55k and 2-4 week lead time.
Maya (Sales): can someone paste an autoscale policy snippet we can include in the SOW? Need cooldowns, burst max window, and fallback mapping.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): draft snippet below - feel free to paste:

autoscale_policy:
  reserved_capacity_gpus: 5
  burst_capacity_max_gpus: 15
  burst_window_seconds: 300  # max continuous burst
  burst_cooldown_seconds: 600
  target_latency_p50_ms: 220
  circuit_break_conditions:
    - metric: p95_latency_ms
      threshold: 1000
      action: failover_to_smaller_model
  fallback_models_order: ["q70B-4bit", "q13B-8bit"]
  kv_cache: true
  batching: auto (max_batch=48)

Noah (Infra): add routing rule: prefer Private cluster if customer on Private plan; else route to hosted region with KMS key binding. Also include a grade-back plan: if failover triggers, redirect a % of traffic to q13B for 60s windows to evaluate quality impact.
Leah (Security): I'll start filling the questionnaire. Confirmations I can provide now: SOC2 report (yes), SAML + SCIM (enterprise only), customer-managed KMS (yes for hosted; HSM attestation for Private), audit log retention up to 12 months (configurable), data deletion SLA 30 days. I can also draft the weights-export prohibition clause for legal.
Maya (Sales): perfect. AE will include both pricing options + security answers + autoscale text in the packet. Ravi, can you run a quick perf sweep for 4/6/8/12 GPUs at batch sizes 8/16/32 and post p50/p95 numbers?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): on it. scheduling a load job now.
ops-bot: Load test job #zt-2225 created by Ravi. ETA ~5h. :hourglass:
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll post results here when done. If p95 > 1s for Option 2 at peak we'll state the fallback to q13B and call out expected latency/quality delta.
Jules (Finance): I'll produce a short pricing one-pager showing committed baseline vs burst sensitivity and an example monthly scenario.
Ibrahim (AE): I'll pre-write an email template for both options and attach the security checklist answers so legal can review the weights-export clause.
Maya (Sales): thanks all - plan: 1) send two-option one-pager + autoscale snippet + questionnaire answers after perf results, 2) align on call tomorrow 8:30am PT, 3) if Private required we trigger SOW and infra prep.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): noted. Will post perf matrix when finished.
Noah (Infra): ping me if you want a Private vs Hosted network diagram for the customer deck.
Leah (Security): will add the legal language and initial questionnaire responses to the doc.
Maya (Sales): closing until perf numbers land. :white_check_mark:
